intervals.note: Uses the approval date as a lower bound; no explicit installation/first-data date for the detector was found in this session (distinct from the experiment's own approval).

placements.note: MoEDAL is deployed inside the LHCb cavern at Point 8, surrounding the intersection region; placed at site:cern-point-8-lhcb (created by the lhcb pass of this same wave), role 'main' since MoEDAL's own detector fully occupies its NTD/trapping-detector footprint there (not a prototype).
placements.quote: The MoEDAL experiment at Point 8 of the LHC ring is the seventh and newest LHC experiment.

area.quote: 125 plastic Nuclear Track Detector (NTD) stacks with a total of 47m2 of deployed plastic

total_mass.quote: Approximately one tonne of trapping detectors to register and retain exotic particles for analysis

summary.plain: MoEDAL's detector is mostly passive: 125 stacks of special plastic sheets that record the tracks of heavily-charged particles, plus about a tonne of metal to trap and hold onto anything unusual.
summary.technical: 125 NTD stacks (47 m^2 total plastic), ~1 t of paramagnetic trapping detectors, TimePix pixel monitors; deployed in the LHCb cavern at Point 8, requiring no trigger or online DAQ for its main passive elements.

technology.quote: 125 plastic Nuclear Track Detector (NTD) stacks with a total of 47m2 of deployed plastic... Approximately one tonne of trapping detectors to register and retain exotic particles for analysis... TimePix pixel detectors for real-time radiation environment assessment
technology.value: passive Nuclear Track Detector (NTD) stacks plus paramagnetic trapping volumes and TimePix pixel monitors
